sn3.24:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho rājā pasenadikosalo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn3.24:1.3: kattha nu kho bhante dānaṃ dātabbanti.
sn3.24:1.6: aññaṃ kho etaṃ mahārāja kattha dānaṃ dātabbaṃ aññaṃ panetaṃ kattha dinnaṃ mahapphalanti
sn3.24:1.7: sīlavato kho mahārāja dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ no tathā dussīle.
sn3.24:1.8: tena hi mahārāja taññevettha paṭipucchissāmi yathā te khameyya tathā naṃ byākareyyāsi.
sn3.24:1.10: idha tyassa yuddhaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ saṅgāmo samupabyūḷho
sn3.24:1.11: atha āgaccheyya khattiyakumāro asikkhito akatahattho akatayoggo akatupāsano bhīru chambhī utrāsī palāyī
sn3.24:1.12: bhareyyāsi taṃ purisaṃ attho ca te tādisena purisenāti.
sn3.24:1.13: nāhaṃ bhante bhareyyaṃ taṃ purisaṃ na ca me attho tādisena purisenāti.
sn3.24:1.17: na ca me attho tādisena purisenāti.
